title: Allow direct develop commits for Kanbus-only updates
description: Clarify the repository Git workflow so project-management-only changes made through the Kanbus CLI may be committed and pushed directly to develop without a pull request. Keep code, configuration, documentation, wiki, and mixed changes under the normal branch and PR workflow.
